notes.title: Small update on November 15, 2024
notes.content:
■ Recent Improvements

□SteamOverlay Support
You can now use Steam features such as taking screenshots with F12, checking achievements, or viewing chat messages from friends directly in-game. (This feature was applied a few days ago, but we’re announcing it for clarity.)

□Sword Attack Fix
Fixed an issue where some attacks would miss when rapidly spamming the attack button. Feel free to mash away now!

□Witch's HP Adjustment
Increased the HP of the Witch slightly to ensure she doesn’t die from a single attack. This change prevents players from experiencing an unfair Game Over when they press a button to start a conversation after breaking the shield.

□Shadow in the Village of Evacuees
Removed the shadow in the forest to the left of the Village, which many reported looked like a bug because it lingered around the player for too long.

□Gamepad Config Text Fixes
Addressed an issue where some Japanese text in the Gamepad Config option wouldn’t display based on language settings. Most text has been unified in English (some text remains due to technical limitations).

□Unused Resources Removed
Removed some unused audio files and images left over from the remaster process. However, a few may still remain.

notes.title: Regarding Steam Deck Play, Achievements, and Translations
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Steam Deck: This game is playable on the Steam Deck with minimal issues, though some unique functions of the Steam Deck aren’t utilized.
[*] Achievements: Added today! All achievements start as hidden, so share hints with others. The final achievement requirement may be challenging to find.
[*] On translation: Japanese translation is being gradually improved with native support, while I’m working to refine the English expressions and phrases for the best possible clarity.
[/list]
